mode: Original Queue WebView login retained; no separate Chrome/CDP, no shop-tab architecture change
observedProblem: Orders still stopped at CUSTOMER_IDENTITY_VERIFICATION although the login form was usable; the panel asked the operator to verify a human check that was not on screen.
causes: Any dialog that did not contain the password input was treated as a human verification, including cookie, privacy, upsell or menu dialogs, so the job paused with no challenge present.
The Resolver's own challenge() used the same rule, so even after a pause the form could not be filled.
A pause that was never completed had no way back: waitingForUser stayed set and canResume was false.
changes: A human check now needs evidence: captcha frame/test id, or verification wording (verify you're human / press and hold / hold the button / checking your browser / unusual activity / Thai equivalents) in the page or a visible dialog. A dialog alone only counts when the login fields are gone.
The same evidence rule is used by the fill/submit guard, so a benign dialog no longer blocks filling.
An unreadable-dialog pause is re-checked after 15s and resumes automatically when the form is still usable; real verification codes never auto-resume.
The visible page text is stored in loginView while waiting, so the panel and ledger show what the window actually displays.
An unfinished verification that reaches its 10 minute limit now leaves the order blocked with its real reason but retryable (canResume) instead of a dead end.

nodeTests.newCases: benign dialog is not a challenge, verification captions are, dialog that replaced the form is a pause, benign dialog still allows filling, 15s grace then resume, real challenge never auto-resumes

nativeBuild: passed x64 compile and full native self-tests

browserSmoke.offlineLogin: passed in real Chrome: dialog layouts, benign dialog over a usable form, captcha captions, zero network requests

installation: Staged 1.3.4 in LOCALAPPDATA and D:\BewpakornQueue-1.0.0\extension; release checksums, live extension hashes and installed host hash verified.
preservedData: Ledger and history untouched. Opening the panel after the reload starts a new host that clears the stale manual wait, so the blocked order becomes retryable.
limitations: A genuine Press-and-hold card still needs one human press; the host then continues automatically. It cannot be bypassed.
Roblox decides when to challenge, so frequency can only be reduced, not guaranteed.
